name: Technical University of Munich
summary: Technical university of about 52,000 students, 45% international; eight English bachelor's in Munich, Garching, Heilbronn and Straubing.

handoff.label: English bachelor's filter (incl. TUM Asia, Singapore)

ib.text: Your six IB subjects must meet the KMK rule; uni-assist converts your IB to a German grade (VPD). Nobody is ranked: five degrees use grade-based aptitude points with an interview or test band, three are open.

dates.label: Application period opens in TUMonline (every English bachelor's)
Application period closes; your VPD request to uni-assist must also be in by today
Semester fee due for first enrolment

programmes.name: Aerospace
programmes.about: Aircraft and spacecraft engineering taught in English, mainly at the Ottobrunn/Taufkirchen aerospace campus with a day a week in Garching in years 1–2; later you pick two focus areas such as propulsion, structures or fluid dynamics.
programmes.ib: German A2 by the deadline (German B HL counts). 8-week pre-study internship, proof by 31 Oct 2027 or within year 1. A 2-page English statement of reasons.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude check (2026/27 rules), no ranking: 80+ points from grades (overall 50%, maths ×3, science ×2, English) admits you; 71–79 means an English interview.

programmes.name: Bioeconomy
programmes.about: Economics and business combined with biology, chemistry and process engineering for bio-based products and the circular economy, on TUM's Straubing campus; year three adds technical electives and bioeconomy governance.
programmes.ib: Mainly English, but some modules may be offered in German only. No language certificate. The online orientation test is compulsory; its result is only advice.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: everyone eligible gets a place. Take the 15-minute online orientation test before 15 July and upload proof; the score does not affect admission.

programmes.name: Geodesy and Earth Observation
programmes.about: Measuring and modelling the Earth in Munich: satellite and physical geodesy, navigation, remote sensing, photogrammetry and geoinformation, with electives such as space geodesy and machine learning on satellite data.
programmes.ib: Good English expected; no certificate. Send a CV and a 2-page English statement of reasons.
programmes.selectionNote: Open for EU/EEA (2026/27 rules): an overall grade worth 64+ points completes the compulsory orientation; below that, an English interview. Its result is only advice.

programmes.name: Information Engineering
programmes.about: Computer science with a business-informatics slant at TUM's Heilbronn campus: programming, algorithms, networks and maths, then electives in informatics and management, to design IT systems from the sensor to the business model.
programmes.ib: German A2 by the deadline (German B HL counts). Taught in English with some German electives. A 2-page English statement of reasons.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude check (2026/27 rules), no ranking: 73+ points (overall grade 65%; maths ×3, English, best science 35%) admits you; 60–72 means an interview, usually by video.

programmes.name: Management and Data Science
programmes.about: Management built around data: every major business field alongside AI, big data and machine learning, taught in English in small classes in Heilbronn and ending in a group project on a real company or research question.
programmes.ib: No language certificate: English is checked through your grades and, if invited, the interview. A 2-page statement on grasping business questions.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude check (2026/27 rules), no ranking: 88+ points (overall grade 65%; maths ×2, science/CS ×2, English 35%) admits you; 67–87 means an English interview.

programmes.name: Management and Technology
programmes.about: A business degree (about 70%) paired with one technical subject (30%) in Munich and Garching, with management specialisations such as finance or entrepreneurship; only the Computer Engineering subject can be studied fully in English.
programmes.ib: Fully in English only with the Computer Engineering specialisation; the others mix English and German. Grades decide, or an admissions test.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude check (2026/27 rules), no ranking: 88+ points (overall grade 65%; maths ×2, science/CS ×2, English 35%) admits you; 67–87 sit a 60-minute test (11 Sep in 2026).

programmes.name: Sustainable Engineering for Materials and Processes
programmes.about: Engineering for greener materials and production on TUM's Straubing campus: materials science, chemistry, physics and process engineering, then a Materials or a Processes specialisation.
programmes.ib: No language certificate. The 20-minute online orientation test is compulsory (upload proof); its result is only advice.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: everyone eligible gets a place. Take the online orientation test before 15 July and upload proof; the score does not affect admission.

programmes.name: Sustainable Management and Technology
programmes.about: Business and economics combined with sustainability and technology (biotechnology, materials, energy and process engineering) on TUM's Straubing campus, with semester 5 kept free for study abroad.
programmes.ib: No English certificate: your school English grades count, or you are interviewed in English. A 2-page statement of reasons.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude check (2026/27 rules), no ranking: 88+ points (overall grade 65%; maths ×2, best science ×2, English 35%) admits you; 67–87 means a 10-minute English interview.

separateFrom.name: Management and Technology
separateFrom.reason: Taught in Straubing, not Munich and Garching, and fully in English; Management and Technology mixes English and German outside one specialisation and asks for grades or a test.

notes: TUM ignores provisional certificates, but a screenshot of your results from the IB portal is enough, so you can apply between results day and 15 July.
With Maths AA or AI at SL the KMK rule limits you to degrees outside maths, science and engineering, unless your school is on the KMK list (Ikast-Brande and Grenaa are).
TUM Asia's English B.Eng. degrees in Singapore are applied for through the Singapore Institute of Technology, not TUMonline.
